paper_type_evidence.quote: Utilizing the Atacama Large Millimeter/Submillimeter Array, we report on detections of \[C II\] 158$\bm{\upmu}$m line and dust continuum emission from two galaxies associated with two such absorbers

question.value: Can the host galaxies of two high-metallicity z~4 damped Lyman-alpha absorbers be detected in [C II] 158 um and dust continuum, and how do they compare with emission-selected galaxies?

evidence.quote: We report here on a search for the galaxies associated with two DLAs at $z \sim 4$ using the Atacama Large Millimeter/Sub-millimeter Array (ALMA).

findings_qualitative.value: [C II] and dust continuum emission detected from both DLA host galaxies, within 100 km/s of the absorption redshift

evidence.quote: are within 100 km s$^{-1}$ of each other

claims.hypothesis: Galaxies associated with high-metallicity z~4 DLAs can be detected in [C II] and dust continuum
claims.experiment: ALMA Band 7 observations of two quasar fields
claims.result: >6 sigma [C II] features at 6.2" and 2.5" offsets, with continuum
claims.finding: The emission arises from DLA host galaxies

evidence.quote: The close proximity in both redshift space and angular separation on the sky indicates that the [C II] 158$\upmu$m emission must come from a galaxy associated with the DLA.

claims.experiment: Compare L_[CII] vs SFR and L_[CII]/L_TIR vs L_TIR with literature samples
claims.result: They lie in the same parameter space as high-z emission-selected galaxies
claims.finding: High-metallicity DLA hosts are similar to massive star-forming galaxies such as massive LBGs

evidence.quote: This strengthens the assertion that high-metallicity, absorption-selected galaxies are similar to moderately star-forming, emission-selected galaxies

claims.hypothesis: Absorbing gas lies within an extended enriched H I reservoir
claims.experiment: Compare impact parameters with [C II] extent and absorption kinematics
claims.result: Impact parameters 18-42 kpc vs [C II] extent ~5 kpc
claims.finding: Absorbers likely probe inner halo gas of the host

evidence.quote: The absorbing gas is therefore more likely to reside in the inner gaseous halo of each DLA host galaxy.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Satellite-galaxy origin of absorption disfavoured, as no [C II] is seen at the absorber position

evidence.quote: The first explanation is disfavored, because the satellite galaxies would need to be metal-enriched

limitations_admitted.value: Inclination not constrained, so M_dyn is a lower limit; SFR systematic factor ~2.5; TIR systematic factor 2.5

evidence.loc: Physical Parameters of the DLA Host Galaxies
